calculation.description: Contrarian five-session asset return signal, strengthened during a rising VIX regime and attenuated when VIX is not rising. Macro and asset observations are lagged/completed bars only.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in each calendar year; annual IC ranged from 0.01227 in 2025 to 0.11852 in 2022. Small cross-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation. Highly correlated with plain five-day reversal; use as a conditional refinement rather than an independent full-weight sleeve.
